title: Phonics Forest
summary: A sound forest where every tree is a phoneme; children match graphemes to sounds and sort word creatures.
mobileSupportNote: Full learning loop verified live at 390x844: compact clearing keeps all three answer leaves above the fold, tap-tap is the primary sort path and every tree is reachable. Declared limited because the grove scrolls past the last tree row and drag precision is lower than tablet — keyboard carry and tap-tap remain fully available.

cover.alt: Staged mastery finale in the sh-tree clearing: one Nordic woodcut conifer centre-frame, its carved sign glowing lantern-gold with 'sh /ʃ/', all three fireflies lit beneath, caption reading 'The tree is awake! — All sounds found. Every firefly is glowing.' with a ghost 'Play again' button and the berry 'Back to the forest' button

desktop.alt: Honest desktop landing: five sound trees (sh, ch, ng, ee, oo) staggered on a fogged hillside, empty firefly slots, 'Every tree keeps one sound' caption

tablet.alt: Hero tablet view of the grove: all five phoneme trees with carved signs visible on one screen, no scrolling

mobile.alt: Honest mobile landing at 390px: four sound trees fully visible in the two-column forest path, the fifth partially below the fold (see the mobile-support note)
